search_text: published ZDI-24-1672 ZDI-CAN-24331 GFI Archiver Store Service Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2024-12-11 CVE-2024-11949 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2024-11949 8.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['GFI'] ['Archiver'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of GFI Archiver. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the Store Service, which listens on TCP port 8018 by default. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in deserialization of untrusted data. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of SYSTEM. Fixed in version 15.7 - https://upgrade.gfi.com/check/gfi-archiver/12x ['2024-06-06 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2024-12-11 - Coordinated public release of advisory', '2024-12-11 - Advisory Updated'] Sina Kheirkhah (@SinSinology) of Summoning Team (@SummoningTeam) https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-24-1672/
title: GFI Archiver Store Service Deserialization of Untrusted Data Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of GFI Archiver. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the Store Service, which listens on TCP port 8018 by default. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of user-supplied data, which can result in deserialization of untrusted data. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of SYSTEM.
